ios.desc:
Train with Precision.
Maximixe your Time Under Tension.

4 Count is your in-class wrist coach for Megaformer & Lagree workouts. Designed to deliver precise haptic feedback, it keeps you locked into a perfect 4-count pace—so you can focus on form, not counting.

The Ultimate Lagree Companion
Clean, rhythmic haptics that help you stay in sync and under tension from first lunge to final plank.

Tap Start. Feel the Tempo.
With a single tap, 4 Count delivers steady, customizable pulses to your Apple Watch—so every second of every rep is purposeful.

Workout Smarter with Sync
Automatically logs to Apple Health, closes your rings, and tracks heart rate. All the data. None of the distractions.

Built for the Method
Designed specifically for the Lagree Method’s slow, controlled cadence—ideal for Megaformer, Microformer, or home-based routines.

Why You’ll Love It
• Haptic Metronome for real-time pacing
• Clutter-free interface built for focus
• Adjustable vibration strength
• Health and heart rate integration
• Seamless auto-logging of workouts

Perfect For:
• Lagree Method loyalists
• Studio and on-demand training
• Time-under-tension strength workouts
• Anyone chasing that slow, shaky burn

No Counting. Just Crushing It.
Join thousands training with intention. 4 Count is the simplest way to get more from every rep.
